Chapter Details: Status of national population, civil, address, land, business, electoral, tax and social protection registers. 44 variables in 8 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: What proportion of land ownership does the register cover?
Comments: A DAI analysis of Malawi land reform notes only three district land registries exist (Blantyre, Lilongwe, Mzuzu) and that wider rollout requires creation of district registries, implying formal registration coverage remains limited (<20%) relative to total land, much of which is customary.
